description: This file implements the CHistoryCollector class, which manages the history of calculator operations, including adding operands, binary operators, unary operators, parentheses, and handling history display updates. It also provides methods for modifying and truncating the history, updating operands based on radix and precision, and managing command objects associated with each history entry.

classes.name: CHistoryCollector
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the calculator's operation history, including adding operands, operators, parentheses, and updating the display.

methods.name: ReinitHistory
methods.description: Resets the internal state variables and clears token and command lists.

methods.name: AddOpndToHistory
methods.description: Adds an operand to the history with its string representation, rational value, and optional repetition flag.

methods.name: RemoveLastOpndFromHistory
methods.description: Removes the last operand from the history.

methods.name: AddBinOpToHistory
methods.description: Adds a binary operator to the history with its opcode, mode, and repetition flag.

methods.name: ChangeLastBinOp
methods.description: Modifies the last binary operator in the history, possibly enclosing it in brackets to invert precedence.

methods.name: PushLastOpndStart
methods.description: Pushes the start index of the last operand onto the operand index stack.

methods.name: PopLastOpndStart
methods.description: Pops the last operand start index from the stack.

methods.name: AddOpenBraceToHistory
methods.description: Adds an opening parenthesis to the history.

methods.name: AddCloseBraceToHistory
methods.description: Adds a closing parenthesis to the history.

methods.name: EnclosePrecInversionBrackets
methods.description: Encloses the previous operand in brackets to invert operator precedence.

methods.name: FOpndAddedToHistory
methods.description: Checks if an operand has been added to the history.

methods.name: AddUnaryOpToHistory
methods.description: Adds a unary operator to the history, wrapping the last operand accordingly.

methods.name: CompleteHistoryLine
methods.description: Finalizes the current history line, adds it to the display, and resets internal state.

methods.name: CompleteEquation
methods.description: Completes the current equation, adds '=' token, updates display, and finalizes the history line.

methods.name: ClearHistoryLine
methods.description: Clears the current history line, optionally preserving the display if an error string is provided.

methods.name: IchAddSzToEquationSz
methods.description: Adds a string to the current equation tokens and returns its index.

methods.name: InsertSzInEquationSz
methods.description: Inserts a string into the equation tokens at a specified position.

methods.name: TruncateEquationSzFromIch
methods.description: Removes tokens from the equation starting from a specified index.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with the current expression tokens and commands.

methods.name: AddCommand
methods.description: Adds a command object to the command list and returns its index.

methods.name: UpdateHistoryExpression
methods.description: Updates operand commands in the history based on current radix and precision.

methods.name: SetDecimalSymbol
methods.description: Sets the decimal symbol used in number parsing.

methods.name: GetOperandCommandsFromString (string_view)
methods.description: Converts a number string into a list of command IDs representing its components.

methods.name: GetOperandCommandsFromString (string_view, Rational const&)
methods.description: Creates an operand command object from a number string and its rational value.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of expression commands representing the current history.
